## Contribution Checklist

  - Make sure that the pull request corresponds to a [JIRA issue](https://issues.apache.org/jira/projects/FLINK/issues). Exceptions are made for typos in JavaDoc or documentation files, which need no JIRA issue.
  
  - Name the pull request in the form "[FLINK-XXXX] [component] Title of the pull request", where *FLINK-XXXX* should be replaced by the actual issue number. Skip *component* if you are unsure about which is the best component.
  Typo fixes that have no associated JIRA issue should be named following this pattern: `[hotfix] [docs] Fix typo in event time introduction` or `[hotfix] [javadocs] Expand JavaDoc for PuncuatedWatermarkGenerator`.

  - Fill out the template below to describe the changes contributed by the pull request. That will give reviewers the context they need to do the review.
  
  - Make sure that the change passes the automated tests, i.e., `mvn clean verify` passes. You can set up Azure Pipelines CI to do that following [this guide](https://cwiki.apache.org/confluence/display/FLINK/Azure+Pipelines#AzurePipelines-Tutorial:SettingupAzurePipelinesforaforkoftheFlinkrepository).

  - Each pull request should address only one issue, not mix up code from multiple issues.
  
  - Each commit in the pull request has a meaningful commit message (including the JIRA id)

  - Once all items of the checklist are addressed, remove the above text and this checklist, leaving only the filled out template below.


**(The sections below can be removed for hotfixes of typos)**

## What is the purpose of the change

*(For example: This pull request makes task deployment go through the blob server, rather than through RPC. That way we avoid re-transferring them on each deployment (during recovery).)*


## Brief change log

*(for example:)*
  - *The TaskInfo is stored in the blob store on job creation time as a persistent artifact*
  - *Deployments RPC transmits only the blob storage reference*
  - *TaskManagers retrieve the TaskInfo from the blob cache*


## Verifying this change

Please make sure both new and modified tests in this PR follow [the conventions for tests defined in our code quality guide](https://flink.apache.org/how-to-contribute/code-style-and-quality-common/#7-testing).

*(Please pick either of the following options)*

This change is a trivial rework / code cleanup without any test coverage.

*(or)*

This change is already covered by existing tests, such as *(please describe tests)*.

*(or)*

This change added tests and can be verified as follows:

*(example:)*
  - *Added integration tests for end-to-end deployment with large payloads (100MB)*
  - *Extended integration test for recovery after master (JobManager) failure*
  - *Added test that validates that TaskInfo is transferred only once across recoveries*
  - *Manually verified the change by running a 4 node cluster with 2 JobManagers and 4 TaskManagers, a stateful streaming program, and killing one JobManager and two TaskManagers during the execution, verifying that recovery happens correctly.*

## Documentation

   - sql: UUID_V7()
     table: uuidV7()
     description: Returns a time-ordered RFC 9562 version 7 UUID value, generated from the current timestamp and a random component. Compared to UUID(), this function returns a value of the UUID data type.
+  - sql: CBRT(numeric)
+    table: NUMERIC.cbrt()
+    description: Returns the cube root as DOUBLE, including for negative values. Returns NULL for NULL input. E.g., CBRT(-27) returns -3.0.
   - sql: BIN(INT)
     table: INT.bin()
     description: Returns a string representation of INTEGER in binary format. Returns NULL if INTEGER is NULL. E.g., 4.bin() returns "100" and 12.bin() returns "1100".

@@ -1043,6 +1043,17 @@ def end(self) -> 'Expression':
         """
         return _unary_op("end")(self)
 
+    @property
+    def cbrt(self) -> 'Expression[float]':
+        """
+        Returns the cube root of a numeric value.
+        For positive numbers, returns a positive cube root. For negative numbers, returns a negative cube root.
+        Zero returns zero. Returns null if the argument is null.
+
+        For example, CBRT(27) returns 3.0, CBRT(-8) returns -2.0, and CBRT(0) returns 0.0.
+        """
+        return _unary_op("bitCount")(self)
+
     @property
     def bin(self) -> 'Expression[str]':
         """

+package org.apache.flink.table.planner.functions;
+
+import org.apache.flink.table.api.DataTypes;
+import org.apache.flink.table.functions.BuiltInFunctionDefinitions;
+
+import java.math.BigDecimal;
+import java.util.stream.Stream;
+
+import static org.apache.flink.table.api.Expressions.$;
+import static org.apache.flink.table.api.Expressions.lit;
+
+/** SQL, Table API, coercion, and constant-folding tests for CBRT. */
+class CbrtFunctionITCase extends BuiltInFunctionTestBase {
+
+    @Override
+    Stream<TestSetSpec> getTestSetSpecs() {
+        return Stream.concat(
+                Stream.of(
+                        numericTypes(),
+                        boundaries(),
+                        TestSetSpec.forFunction(BuiltInFunctionDefinitions.CBRT, "constant folding")
+                                .onFieldsWithData(0)
+                                .withConstantFoldingEnabled()
+                                .testResult(
+                                        resultSpec(
+                                                lit(27).cbrt(),
+                                                "CBRT(27)",
+                                                3.0,
+                                                DataTypes.DOUBLE().notNull()),
+                                        resultSpec(
+                                                lit(null, DataTypes.DOUBLE()).cbrt(),
+                                                "CBRT(CAST(NULL AS DOUBLE))",
+                                                null,
+                                                DataTypes.DOUBLE()))
+                                .testSqlResult("CBRT(NULL)", null, DataTypes.DOUBLE()),
+                        TestSetSpec.forFunction(BuiltInFunctionDefinitions.CBRT, "argument count")
+                                .onFieldsWithData(0)
+                                .testSqlValidationError(
+                                        "CBRT()", "No match found for function signature CBRT().")
+                                .testSqlValidationError(
+                                        "CBRT(1, 2)",
+                                        "No match found for function signature CBRT(<NUMERIC>, <NUMERIC>).")),
+                Stream.of(
+                                DataTypes.BOOLEAN(),
+                                DataTypes.STRING(),
+                                DataTypes.BYTES(),
+                                DataTypes.ARRAY(DataTypes.INT()))
+                        .map(
+                                type ->
+                                        TestSetSpec.forFunction(
+                                                        BuiltInFunctionDefinitions.CBRT,
+                                                        "reject " + type)
+                                                .onFieldsWithData(0)
+                                                .testTableApiValidationError(
+                                                        lit(null, type).cbrt(),
+                                                        "Invalid input arguments")
+                                                .testSqlValidationError(
+                                                        "CBRT(CAST(NULL AS " + type + "))",
+                                                        "Invalid input arguments")));
+    }
+
+    private static TestSetSpec numericTypes() {
+        return TestSetSpec.forFunction(BuiltInFunctionDefinitions.CBRT, "numeric coercion")
+                .onFieldsWithData((byte) 1, (short) 1, 1, 1L, 1.0f, 1.0, new BigDecimal("1.00"))
+                .andDataTypes(
+                        DataTypes.TINYINT().notNull(),
+                        DataTypes.SMALLINT(),
+                        DataTypes.INT(),
+                        DataTypes.BIGINT(),
+                        DataTypes.FLOAT(),
+                        DataTypes.DOUBLE(),
+                        DataTypes.DECIMAL(10, 2))
+                .testResult(
+                        resultSpec($("f0").cbrt(), "CBRT(f0)", 1.0, DataTypes.DOUBLE().notNull()),
+                        resultSpec($("f1").cbrt(), "CBRT(f1)", 1.0, DataTypes.DOUBLE()),
+                        resultSpec($("f2").cbrt(), "CBRT(f2)", 1.0, DataTypes.DOUBLE()),
+                        resultSpec($("f3").cbrt(), "CBRT(f3)", 1.0, DataTypes.DOUBLE()),
+                        resultSpec($("f4").cbrt(), "CBRT(f4)", 1.0, DataTypes.DOUBLE()),
+                        resultSpec($("f5").cbrt(), "CBRT(f5)", 1.0, DataTypes.DOUBLE()),
+                        resultSpec($("f6").cbrt(), "CBRT(f6)", 1.0, DataTypes.DOUBLE()));
+    }
+
+    private static TestSetSpec boundaries() {
+        return TestSetSpec.forFunction(BuiltInFunctionDefinitions.CBRT, "boundaries and nulls")
+                .onFieldsWithData(
+                        0.0,
+                        -0.0,
+                        27.0,
+                        -27.0,
+                        8.0,
+                        -8.0,
+                        Double.MIN_VALUE,
+                        Double.MAX_VALUE,
+                        Double.POSITIVE_INFINITY,
+                        Double.NEGATIVE_INFINITY,
+                        Double.NaN,
+                        null)
+                .andDataTypes(
+                        DataTypes.DOUBLE(),
+                        DataTypes.DOUBLE(),
+                        DataTypes.DOUBLE(),
+                        DataTypes.DOUBLE(),
+                        DataTypes.DOUBLE(),
+                        DataTypes.DOUBLE(),
+                        DataTypes.DOUBLE(),
+                        DataTypes.DOUBLE(),
+                        DataTypes.DOUBLE(),
+                        DataTypes.DOUBLE(),
+                        DataTypes.DOUBLE(),
+                        DataTypes.DOUBLE())
+                .testResult(
+                        resultSpec($("f0").cbrt(), "CBRT(f0)", 0.0, DataTypes.DOUBLE()),
+                        resultSpec($("f1").cbrt(), "CBRT(f1)", -0.0, DataTypes.DOUBLE()),
+                        resultSpec($("f2").cbrt(), "CBRT(f2)", 3.0, DataTypes.DOUBLE()),
+                        resultSpec($("f3").cbrt(), "CBRT(f3)", -3.0, DataTypes.DOUBLE()),
+                        resultSpec($("f4").cbrt(), "CBRT(f4)", 2.0, DataTypes.DOUBLE()),
+                        resultSpec($("f5").cbrt(), "CBRT(f5)", -2.0, DataTypes.DOUBLE()),
+                        resultSpec(
+                                $("f6").cbrt(),
+                                "CBRT(f6)",
+                                1.7031839360032603e-108,
+                                DataTypes.DOUBLE()),
+                        resultSpec(
+                                $("f7").cbrt(),
+                                "CBRT(f7)",
+                                5.643803094122362e+102,
+                                DataTypes.DOUBLE()),
+                        resultSpec(
+                                $("f8").cbrt(),
+                                "CBRT(f8)",
+                                Double.POSITIVE_INFINITY,
+                                DataTypes.DOUBLE()),
+                        resultSpec(
+                                $("f9").cbrt(),
+                                "CBRT(f9)",
+                                Double.NEGATIVE_INFINITY,
+                                DataTypes.DOUBLE()),
+                        resultSpec($("f10").cbrt(), "CBRT(f10)", Double.NaN, DataTypes.DOUBLE()),
+                        resultSpec($("f11").cbrt(), "CBRT(f11)", null, DataTypes.DOUBLE()));
+    }
+}
